analysis.summary: Scene marker test clip featuring the same woman across three distinct settings: cozy morning at home with coffee, professional night work in city office, and sunny outdoor park walk. Demonstrates scene transitions with voice markers 'First, second, third' for testing scene detection and segmentation.

frames.text: Black woman with hair pulled back, wearing cream cable-knit sweater, holding white coffee mug and smiling warmly. Bright window with flowers visible in background. Cozy morning-at-home atmosphere with natural lighting.
Same woman looking down at her coffee mug with a gentle smile, still in the cozy home setting. Warm lighting, relaxed morning mood before the scene transition.

Scene change to office setting - the same woman now wears a navy blue blazer, working intently on a laptop. Night-time city skyline with lit buildings visible through floor-to-ceiling windows behind her.
Office scene continues - professional woman typing on laptop, illuminated by screen glow and ambient city lights. Modern corporate environment with urban nightscape backdrop.
Still in office, the woman smiles while working. Subtitle text 'first' visible on screen, suggesting scene marker testing. Night city view continues in background.
Third scene - outdoors in sunny park setting. Same woman wearing light denim jacket over colorful floral dress, standing on tree-lined pathway. Bright daylight, lush green trees.
